title: arc-scores/1
description: The per-query score file behind one VerdictRow (rows[].scores_file). `arcforge verdict` recomputes the row's point, CIs, p-value and seed SD from it (arcforge/contract/stats.py). Estimators: 'pigeonhole' (difference rows: two-way bootstrap over source and target records), 'cluster_ratio' (ratio rows: record-clustered bootstrap over target records), 'refit_pooled' (P@k rows: the labelled-item bootstrap pooled over the point fit and every refit).

seeds.description: Seed labels, one per column of every item's a/b arrays (an arm with one column is deterministic and is broadcast).

id.description: Query (or pair, or lexeme) id; unique.

part.description: Sub-stratum for macro-averaging: AB pools A and B with equal weight; single-stratum rows use one part.

source.description: The source record (cluster) of the query, or null.

targets.description: The relevant target records (clusters). A query's bootstrap weight is its source multiplicity x the mean multiplicity of its targets. An item with neither is its own cluster.

labels.description: refit_pooled: the owner's blind labels (1 = re-meant). Ranked items without a label count as not re-meant (conservative).

fits.description: refit_pooled: the point fit (id 'point') and every refit, each with arm_a's and arm_b's ranking (most re-meant first).
